title: llm-kit consent file, schema 2
description: The user-level consent file: LLM_KIT_CONSENT_FILE, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/llm-kit/consent.json (fallback $HOME/.config/llm-kit/consent.json); never a file in a project tree. Written in llm-scripting-kit.json-schema-subset/v1. It holds the machine owner's cost-class policy (the global classes and named scopes; applied only when a caller opts in) and connection approvals (always applied: a project connection that sends a key is used only when an approval names its endpoint, host and key variable). Reader rules the subset cannot state: a scope name has no leading or trailing whitespace; an approval's endpoint has no leading or trailing whitespace; its host is a lower-case DNS name or IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address in brackets, with an optional :port; its key_env is an ASCII letter or _, then ASCII letters, digits and _. Contract and shared cases: docs/reference/llm-kit-formats.md.

updated_at.description: When the file was last written (ISO 8601, UTC). The reader does not check it.

classes.description: The cost classes a scope states; a class it omits takes the global value.

approval.description: The machine owner's approval of a project connection that sends a key: this machine may send the key that environment variable key_env holds to host, for a project model file endpoint named endpoint. host is the host of the connection's base_url in lower case, with the port the URL names.
